_🔒 Security & Privacy_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Limit the workflow token to repository read access.**

Both jobs run commands from the checked-out repository. Without a `permissions` declaration, they inherit the repository's default `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions. If those defaults include write access, a push that changes a hook, test, or checker can run that code with a write-capable token. Set `permissions: contents: read` for this workflow or for both jobs. ([github.com](https://github.com/actions/checkout/blob/main/README.md?plain=1&utm_source=openai))
